inputs: particles.wgsl's entry points, each drawn into its own rgba16float target with the frame's additive blend (color one + one, alpha kept at the clear's 0) and stacked as panels of one 32 × 48 output. Rows 0-15, vs + fs (the dot draw, kind 0) over 32 × 16 with no depth attachment (an empty reversed-Z depth passes every sprite): an orthographic clip maps world (x, y) to px (x, y), y down, z 0.5; size 8 px at birth and death (size scale 1), so a dot's half extent is 4 px; opacity 1 at birth and death, opacity scale 1; two color stops, at 0 of life the linear color (0.8, 8/15, 4/15), codes (204, 136, 68), at 0.5 the color of codes (40, 200, 240); dot 0 at (4.5, 4.5) at 0 of its life, dot 1 at (11.5, 11.5) at 0.5, and slot 2 at (8, 8) with age over life -1, not alive. A dot's pixel at offset at (in half extents) adds color × (1 - |at|²)² × opacity × (1 - life). Rows 16-23, vs + half_fs (a puff, kind 2) into the 32 × 8 half-size target of a 64 × 16 view, the same clip for 64 × 16, size 10 px (half extent 5 full px, 2.5 half px), one stop whose color × 0.35 is codes (68, 44, 20); puff 0 at full px (7, 7) and puff 1 at (39, 7), both at 0 of life; the scene's depth (64 × 16) is 1.0, nearer than the puffs' 0.5, at full px x ≥ 32 on odd rows and 0 elsewhere. A half pixel adds color × 0.35 exp(-3 |at|²) × the share of its four full pixels whose depth is at most 0.5. Rows 24-31, upsample_vs + upsample_fs from a 16 × 4 input; rows 32-39, upsample_vs + upsample_full_fs from a 32 × 8 input; rows 40-47, upsample_vs + upsample_quarter_fs from an 8 × 2 input; each a 32 × 8 target, a linear clamp-to-edge sampler, and an input of two tones by column (texel (v, v ÷ 2, 0, 1) in codes): v = 40 left of input column 8 and 200 from it; 60 left of 16 and 180 from it; 40 left of 4 and 200 from it. Pixel x samples input texel coordinate (x + 0.5) × k - 0.5 with k = 0.5, 1 and 0.25

expect.why: dot 0's centre pixel, at = 0: shape (1 - 0)² = 1, opacity 1 × (1 - 0) = 1, its color at life 0 is stop 0's: (204, 136, 68); the alpha the blend keeps is the clear's 0
dot 1's centre pixel: shape 1, life 0.5 sits on stop 1, so its color is (40, 200, 240), times opacity 1 × (1 - 0.5) = 0.5: (20, 100, 120)
dot 0 at pixel centre (6.5, 6.5), 2 px right and down of its centre: at = (0.5, 0.5), |at|² = 0.5, shape (1 - 0.5)² = 0.25: (204, 136, 68) × 0.25 = (51, 34, 17)
outside both dots' quads (dot 0's reaches y 8.5): only the clear, 0
where slot 2 would sit: it isn't alive, so it draws nothing; dot 0 is at |at|² = (1, 1) → 2 and dot 1 at (0.75, 0.75) → 1.125, both past the disc, so the clear's 0

half_fs: puff 0's centre, half pixel (3, 3) at (3.5, 3.5) = full (7, 7) ÷ 2: at = 0, shape 0.35 exp(0) = 0.35, life 0 so opacity 1; its four full pixels (6-7, 6-7) are left of x 32, depth 0, all shown: 1 × the stop's (68, 44, 20)

half_fs: puff 1's centre, half pixel (19, 3) = full (39, 7) ÷ 2: shape 0.35, but of its four full pixels (38-39, 6-7) row 7 is odd and past x 32, depth 1.0 nearer than 0.5: two hidden, shown 0.5: (68, 44, 20) × 0.5 = (34, 22, 10)
half_fs: between the puffs (puff 0 reaches half x 6, puff 1 starts at 17): the clear

upsample_full_fs: from 16 on its own texel, 180, 90
